title: Gmail Bulk Unsubscribe & Cleanup Tool  #github #gmail
description:
Your Gmail inbox is stressing you out? Let me show you something insane. This open-source tool lets you instantly clean up your Gmail — unsubscribe, delete junk, and mark thousands of emails as read… all with one click. And the best part? It’s 100% local. No servers, no tracking, no data collection.

https://github.com/Gururagavendra/gmail-cleaner
